name: Server Configuration — .htaccess Override
description:
📖 Scenario

The final application uses Apache configuration rules to determine how uploaded files are processed.

A file-upload mechanism is available, but its interaction with .htaccess configuration files may create an unexpected behavior.

🎯 Mission

Investigate:

http://flag2.cgcybercom.online/index.php

Determine whether the server allows an uploaded .htaccess file to alter how .txt files are interpreted.

🎯 Objective

Successfully trigger the intended server-side behavior and retrieve the flag.


Submit only the required answer using the flag format: pcgCTF{answer}
